verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no product feature for setting up autonomous background automations. The MCP server, Agent Toolkit, SDK, API keys and checkout-status webhooks are developer building blocks someone could use to build automations, not the capability itself. The single 'automated marketing' mention in a POS plan is an adjacent marketing feature, not user-configurable background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
